input.quote: 14.10 Complete Understanding. This Agreement including all Exhibits, and the Non Disclosure Agreement and the Statement of Work referenced in this Agreement and incorporated by reference herein, constitutes the final, complete and exclusive agreement between the parties with respect to the subject matter hereof, and supersedes any prior or contemporaneous agreement.
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no insurance clause: the outline shows no insurance heading, the only textual hit for "insurance" is an unrelated revenue deduction in the definitions (p0012), and neither Miscellaneous (Section 14) nor Shared Resources (Section 13) imposes any coverage obligation. Commerce One is the vendor here (Corio is the licensee/hosting customer): it supplies the Software and MarketSite service and provides operations, consulting and engineering personnel who work alongside Corio personnel and touch Corio's hosted environment and data, so this is squarely a services/hosting vendor for which the playbook expects coverage. Absence of any insurance for a vendor with access to our data is walk-away territory, so we inserted a short covenant at the preferred levels (CGL 1M/2M, E&O 2M, cyber 5M, workers' compensation, certificates on request) in Section 14, noting the E&O 1M / cyber 2M fallback is available. Numbering of the new clause can be conformed on execution.

proposal.summary: Insert vendor insurance covenant in Section 14 (Miscellaneous)
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We added a standard insurance covenant, as Commerce One supplies hosted services and personnel who work with Corio systems and data; our playbook requires CGL of USD 1M/2M, E&O of USD 2M and cyber liability of USD 5M where our data is processed, with certificates on request. If helpful, we can accept E&O of USD 1M and cyber of USD 2M as a fallback.

ops.text: 14.11 Insurance. Commerce One shall maintain, at its own expense, throughout the term of this Agreement and for one (1) year thereafter: (a) commercial general liability insurance of not less than USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 in the aggregate; (b) professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than USD 2,000,000; (c) where Commerce One processes, stores or has access to data of Corio or its Customers, cyber and privacy liability insurance of not less than USD 5,000,000; and (d) workers' compensation insurance as required by applicable law. Commerce One shall provide Corio with certificates of insurance evidencing such coverage upon request.
